company_name: SHENZHEN SELEN CLEAN TECH Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides contamination control and clean room technologies, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Shenzhen Selen Clean Tech Co., Ltd specializes in contamination control and clean room technologies, offering advanced HVAC systems and ESD control solutions. Their expertise in polymer polymerization and precision coating supports the production of high-performance films and tapes for various industries, including consumer electronics and automotive.
